### 5.10.1 Knowledge lineage in building environments

Learning environments should be part of the development stack, where participants build, maintain, and pass systems on. Lineage-based learning and nonlinear exploration can connect present work to the decisions, experiments, and people that preceded it. This treats education as a long-term community practice rather than only a sequence of marketable skills.
